bots.name: Opportunity Hunter
bots.about: Agent jo Binance ke top 100 coins roz scan karta hai. Us din ke top-30 volume wale coins mein se jo 3 sab se mazboot trend mein hon (14 din ka risk-adjusted return), unhein khareedta hai, aur trend tootne pe bech ke agla behtar coin le leta hai. Sirf tab khareedta hai jab BTC khud apne 50-din average se upar ho (BTC filter). Backtest: +47%/saal, lekin giraav -54% tak. Bohot risky.

bots.name: Momentum Daily
bots.about: Roz ek baar (daily candle) dekhta hai. Coin ka 50 din ka average aur 30 din ka return dono upar hon to coin rakhta hai, warna bech deta hai. Har coin ko 1/3 paisa. Backtest mein sab se zyada profit, lekin giraav bhi bara (-36% tak). Trades kam aur lambi hoti hain (hafton ki).

bots.name: Trend Rider 4h
bots.about: Aap ka pehla bot. Uptrend mein 20 candles ka high toote to khareedta hai, aur har trade pe stop-loss lagata hai (sirf 0.75% risk). Profit kam, lekin giraav sab se kam (-15%).

bots.name: Trend Rider 1h
bots.about: Wahi trend strategy, lekin ghante ki candles pe. Trades zyada aur jaldi hoti hain. Backtest mein profit kam tha (+5%/saal), kyunke fees zyada lagti hain.

bots.name: Fast Scalper (Day Trading)
bots.about: Asli day trading: din mein kai trades, chhoti girawat pe khareed ke uchaal pe bechna. Ye bot sirf dikhane ke liye hai ke tez trading mein fees kaise profit kha jaati hain. Backtest mein -43%/saal tha. Isse asli paise pe kabhi na chalayein.

bots.name: Dip Catcher
bots.about: Agent jo top coins mein se sab se zyada gire hue (oversold, RSI-14 25 se neeche) coin dhoondta hai aur khareedta hai. +12% pe profit book, -8% pe stop-loss, ya 10 din baad bech deta hai. Har trade ka anjaam pehle se tay hai. Backtest: +13%/saal, giraav -28%, aadhi se zyada trades jeet. Girte market mein bhi mauqe dhoondta hai.

bots.name: Buy & Hold (Benchmark)
bots.about: Muqable ke liye: teeno coins khareed ke rakh liye, kabhi nahi bechte. Agar koi bot is se kam kamaye aur giraav bhi zyada ho, to wo bot bekaar hai.
